quant-trend.mission: Research and improve trend-following strategy logic with strict no-lookahead, realistic costs, untouched OOS validation, and fail-closed promotion rules.

quant-mean-reversion.mission: Research and improve mean-reversion strategy logic while resisting overfitting and preserving untouched OOS and realistic execution assumptions.

quant-breakout-volatility.mission: Research breakout and volatility-expansion strategies with regime robustness, no-lookahead execution, and realistic fees/spread/slippage.

quant-cross-asset.mission: Research relative-strength, cross-asset and multi-timeframe signals without leaking future data or weakening OOS standards.

data-market.mission: Improve exchange coverage, liquid-universe selection, historical/live market data access and symbol availability including safe PONS handling.

data-integrity.mission: Detect and fail closed on stale, missing, malformed, duplicated or timestamp-inconsistent market data.

market-microstructure.mission: Improve spread, slippage, liquidity, funding, basis and execution-cost modeling using evidence available in the repository.

onchain-tokenomics.mission: Build fail-closed on-chain and tokenomics intelligence that can support research without fabricating unavailable data or bypassing validation.

news-macro.mission: Build timestamp-safe news and macro catalyst features for research, with explicit freshness and provenance checks and no future-information leakage.

strategy-registry.mission: Build longitudinal champion/challenger selection, robust promotion/demotion, drift monitoring, and fail-closed approval gates.

portfolio-risk.mission: Improve position sizing, concentration, correlation exposure, volatility targeting, portfolio heat, drawdown protection and kill switches.

production-signals.mission: Improve live Top-20 BUY/SELL/WAIT ranking, entry/stop/target construction and dashboard consistency while keeping unapproved research out of production.

testing-security.mission: Adversarially test security, lookahead, malformed inputs, dependency/CI regressions and failures that must produce safe WAIT or RESEARCH_ONLY outcomes.

infra-cost.mission: Reduce cloud and API waste, improve reliability and observability, and document measurable cost controls without weakening safety or changing protected orchestration files.
